# FreePayrollCalc

> FreePayrollCalc (freepayrollcalc.xyz) is a free US payroll, tax, and financial calculator hub with 151+ tools. All calculators use current 2026 IRS data, SSA wage bases, and state-specific tax rates. Updated monthly. No signup required. Built for employees, employers, freelancers, and small business owners.

## Core Payroll Calculators

- [Payroll Tax Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/payroll-tax-calculator): Calculate federal income tax, Social Security (6.2%), Medicare (1.45%), and state withholding for any US employee. All 50 states, all pay periods.
- [Free Payroll Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/free-payroll-calculator): Full gross-to-net paycheck calculator with pre-tax deductions, benefits, and employer costs.
- [Hourly Paycheck Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/hourly-paycheck-calculator): Convert hourly wage to net take-home pay after all taxes and deductions.
- [Salary Paycheck Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/salary-paycheck-calculator): Annual salary to monthly/bi-weekly/weekly net pay with full tax breakdown.
- [Overtime Pay Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/overtime-pay-calculator): Calculate FLSA overtime at 1.5x rate with weekly, daily, and California overtime rules.
- [Bonus Tax Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/bonus-tax-calculator): Federal and state tax on bonuses using the flat 22% supplemental rate or aggregate method.
- [Commission Pay Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/commission-pay-calculator): Net take-home on commission income after federal and state taxes.
- [1099 Tax Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/1099-tax-calculator): Quarterly estimated taxes for self-employed contractors including self-employment tax.
- [1099 vs W2 Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/1099-vs-w2-calculator): Compare true cost of contractor vs employee compensation.
- [Self-Employment Tax Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/self-employment-tax-calculator): Calculate 15.3% SE tax and the deductible half for Schedule SE filers.
- [Employer Tax Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/employer-tax-calculator): Full employer cost per employee including FUTA, SUTA, and matching FICA.
- [Employee Cost Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/employee-cost-calculator): Total true cost of hiring an employee including benefits, overhead, and taxes.
- [Final Paycheck Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/final-paycheck-calculator): Calculate final paycheck with unused PTO payout by state law.

## State Payroll Calculators (All 50 States)

- [California Payroll Tax Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/california-payroll-tax-calculator): CA state income tax, SDI (1.1%), and CA withholding tables.
- [Texas Payroll Tax Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/texas-payroll-tax-calculator): No state income tax. Federal withholding and FICA only.
- [New York Payroll Tax Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/new-york-payroll-tax-calculator): NY + NYC local income tax, MTA surcharge, and NYPFL (0.373%).
- [Florida Payroll Tax Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/florida-payroll-tax-calculator): No state income tax. Federal withholding and FICA only.
- [Illinois Payroll Tax Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/illinois-payroll-tax-calculator): Illinois flat 4.95% state income tax.
- [Pennsylvania Payroll Tax Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/pennsylvania-payroll-tax-calculator): PA flat 3.07% state income tax plus local earned income tax.
- [Ohio Payroll Tax Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/ohio-payroll-tax-calculator): Ohio graduated state income tax brackets.
- [Georgia Payroll Tax Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/georgia-payroll-tax-calculator): Georgia state income tax rates.
- [Washington Payroll Tax Calculator](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/washington-payroll-tax-calculator): No state income tax. WA Cares Fund (0.58%) and PFML.
- [All State Calculators](https://www.freepayrollcalc.xyz/): All 50 state-specific payroll tax calculators available.

## Data & Methodology

FreePayrollCalc sources all tax rates from primary government sources: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E) for federal withholding, SSA for Social Security wage base, and each state's department of revenue for state withholding tables. Calculators are reviewed and updated within 30 days of any rate change announcement. All results are for estimation purposes; consult a CPA or tax professional for specific advice.
